title: Assess reads each trade's must-haves off the old site's research: missing only when the read could see it, a score reason and outreach lines only the demo backs
steps: S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The table names food, beauty, health, fitness and hospitality by the trade ids of trades.mjs; a pharmacy has none, a coach no class schedule.
A restaurant whose whole site was read with no menu and no booking has menu missing, booking missing and ordering unknown (not-detectable), so booking-or-ordering is unknown.
No read, a failed or partial read, a salon's booking and every form are unknown with a reason, never missing; a one-page site's menu or booking words make it present.
The demo offers a booking only with a verified booking link in its brief and a menu only with the full menu section.
An outreach line exists only for a capability known missing that the demo offers: 'Your site has no online booking; the demo does.'
scoreOpportunity without mustHaves is unchanged (golden hash); with them a missing must-have adds trade.missing worth its share of 15, and a slow site reaches at most 40 web points.

tests: the table names the five trades by the ids WO uses, each must-have met by known capabilities
a restaurant whose whole site was read with no menu and no booking: the menu is missing, booking known absent
a one-page site that shows its menu or a booking line in its text is never told it has none
unknown is unknown: no read, a failed read, a partial read, an undetectable capability, forms
the demo offers what its brief knows: a verified booking link, the full menu section
an outreach line only for a capability known missing that the demo really has
score: a missing must-have is a reason worth its share of 15; without an assessment nothing changes
score: a slow site that lacks every must-have reaches the 40 web points of a site that is down, not more
a restaurant read in full with no menu and no booking: the reason, and the lines its demo backs
golden: the built-in rules score the fixture set exactly as the single function did before the split
